# Deliberately self-contained: this view is a copy-me artefact, so it
	# must not depend on a script package existing in the host project.
	# The list is read from the GATEWAY, not written here, so a theme pack
	# installed after this view was copied appears without editing it, and
	# a theme that is not installed can never be picked.
	from java.lang import Throwable as JThrowable
	# light and dark live inside the Perspective module's own jar and never
	# appear as config resources, so the stock six are a fixed base rather
	# than something read from the gateway. Order is Ignition's own.
	stock = [u"light", u"light-warm", u"light-cool",
	         u"dark", u"dark-warm", u"dark-cool"]
	extra = []
	try:
		for res in system.config.getResources(
				moduleId="com.inductiveautomation.perspective", typeId="themes"):
			name = unicode(res.getName())
			if name not in stock and name not in extra:
				extra.append(name)
	except (JThrowable, Exception) as e:
		# a dropdown offering the stock six beats one offering nothing
		system.util.getLogger("ThemeSelector").warn(
			u"theme listing failed, offering the stock themes only: %s" % e)
	return [{u"value": n, u"label": n.replace(u"-", u" ").capitalize()}
	        for n in stock + sorted(extra)]
